title: [Nichibei] Add Student Popup – Archived LA Excluded on the Live Nichibei Org
description: AC-5 (parity) - Regression: Manual verification of an already code-confirmed-safe path, run specifically against the Nichibei org to rule out deployment/config drift.
preconditions:
HQ or CM Staff is logged in to the Nichibei Salesforce org
A lesson exists for a Nichibei course on 2026-05-20. Student A has a Lesson Allocation for that course, archived (Archived_At__c populated, via its order group being fully removed). Student B has an active Lesson Allocation for the same course
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff opens the lesson's Student tab on the Nichibei org and clicks Add Student"
2. "HQ or CM Staff searches for Student A and Student B"
3. "A living Student Package Order reappears for Student A's Student Course, so the Lesson Allocation is unarchived on the same record Id"
4. "HQ or CM Staff reopens Add Student and searches for Student A"
steps_result:
1. "The Add Student modal opens"
2. "Student A does not appear (archived); Student B appears (active)"
3. "The Lesson Allocation shows Archived_At__c blank again"
4. "Student A now appears, selectable exactly like Student B"
steps_data:
1. ""
2. "Student A Archived_At__c = populated; Student B Archived_At__c = blank"
3. "Archived_At__c = null (restored)"
4. "Student A Archived_At__c = blank (restored)"
suite: Nichibei — Shared Core Surfaces (Add Student / Calendar / LA Tab)

title: [Nichibei] Calendar Student List – Archived Student Hidden on the Live Nichibei Org
description: AC-5 (parity) - Regression: Manual verification on the live Nichibei org, mirroring the Core case already covered in lesson-calendar-display-archive.md.
preconditions:
HQ or CM Staff is logged in to the Nichibei Salesforce org
A lesson on the SF/BO Calendar has Student A (active Lesson Allocation, currently shown in the lesson's student roster) and Student B (active Lesson Allocation)
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff opens the lesson from the Calendar and views its student roster"
2. "The Student Package Order group behind Student A's Lesson Allocation is fully removed, so the Lesson Allocation is archived"
3. "HQ or CM Staff reopens the lesson from the Calendar and views the roster again"
4. "A living Student Package Order reappears for Student A's Student Course, so the Lesson Allocation is unarchived on the same record Id"
5. "HQ or CM Staff reopens the lesson from the Calendar"
steps_result:
1. "Both Student A and Student B are listed"
2. "Student A's Student Session becomes Is_Archived__c = TRUE via formula"
3. "Student A no longer appears; Student B is unaffected"
4. "Student A's Student Session returns to Is_Archived__c = FALSE"
5. "Student A reappears in the roster - the same original session, not newly created"
steps_data:
1. "Both sessions Is_Archived__c = FALSE"
2. "Archived_At__c = current timestamp"
3. "Student A excluded by the roster query's Is_Archived__c = FALSE filter"
4. "Archived_At__c = null (restored)"
5. "Both sessions shown again"
suite: Nichibei — Shared Core Surfaces (Add Student / Calendar / LA Tab)

title: [Nichibei] Lesson Allocation Tab – All 8 List Views Exclude an Archived LA on the Live Nichibei Org
description: AC-5 (parity) - Regression: Manual verification on the live Nichibei org, confirming the same 8 declarative list views behave identically, with no additional Nichibei-only view and no profile-specific divergence.
preconditions:
HQ or CM Staff is logged in to the Nichibei Salesforce org, with access to the Lesson Allocation tab
Student A has a Lesson Allocation for a Nichibei course, Require Allocation = True, Academic Year = 2024, status = Partially Assigned. It currently appears in the All, All_2024, and Partially_Assigned_2024 list views
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff navigates to the Lesson Allocation tab on the Nichibei org and confirms the full list of available list views matches the 8 already known from Core"
2. "HQ or CM Staff confirms the LA appears in All, All_2024, and Partially_Assigned_2024"
3. "The Student Package Order behind this Lesson Allocation is fully removed, so the Lesson Allocation is archived"
4. "HQ or CM Staff checks each of the 8 list views in turn"
5. "A living Student Package Order reappears for Student A's Student Course, so the Lesson Allocation is unarchived on the same record Id"
6. "HQ or CM Staff checks All, All_2024, and Partially_Assigned_2024 again"
steps_result:
1. "Exactly the same 8 views are available, no more, no fewer"
2. "The LA is visible in all three"
3. "The Lesson Allocation shows Archived_At__c populated"
4. "The Lesson Allocation does not appear in any of the 8 views, including Recently_Updated despite its LastModifiedDate having just changed"
5. "The Lesson Allocation shows Archived_At__c blank again"
6. "The LA reappears in all three, correctly re-categorized by its actual status, not miscategorized"
steps_data:
1. "List view set = All, All_2023, All_2024, Fully_Assigned_2024, None_Assigned_2024, Over_Assigned_2024, Partially_Assigned_2024, Recently_Updated"
2. "Archived_At__c = blank -> included"
3. "Archived_At__c = current timestamp"
4. "All 8 views share the same Archived_At__c equals (blank) filter"
5. "Archived_At__c = null (restored)"
6. "Archived_At__c = blank (restored) -> included"
suite: Nichibei — Shared Core Surfaces (Add Student / Calendar / LA Tab)
